notes.title: Small update, weapons and bug fixes
notes.notes:
I want to share with you a little news. There is not so much free time now, so I don’t manage to get away with the project a lot of time. But all exactly thanks to those who follow and support!

Now I am working on weapons for the game and small bug fixes. While there will be available 2 types of melee weapons - a pipe and a club with nails. Each will have its own special properties and will eventually break.

notes.title: New Update! Version 0.0.2 Pre-Alpha
Update Pre-Alpha 0.0.2 soon!
notes.notes:
Up to the end of this month Pre-Alpha 0.0.2 update will be released!
Some bugs will be fixed, a new kind of girls will be added (for now the secret) and the rebalance of the game economy (special thanks to Agenterror).

Thank you all for your support!
